build_Deimv2Loss_criterion: build a Deimv2Loss criterion from config for object detection training with MAL and dense one-to-one matching
compute_loss_labels_mal: compute the Matching Aware Loss using IoU-weighted soft labels and focal-style weighting for matched predictions
resolve_dense_o2o_indices: resolve dense one-to-one matching indices across auxiliary layer outputs for unified box assignment
dispatch_get_loss: dispatch to the named loss function like mal, boxes, or local for a given set of outputs and targets
run_Deimv2ForObjectDetectionLoss: run the DEIMv2 object detection loss computation with auxiliary and denoising outputs for end-to-end training
